components.name: Primary action
components.description: The current workflow’s main action, including Prepare and Start private review.
components.css: .ds-primary { min-height:44px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:10px 16px; border:1px solid var(--accent-hover,var(--accent)); border-radius:10px; background:var(--accent-hover,var(--accent)); color:var(--accent-fg); font:500 14px var(--font); cursor:pointer; transition:background .14s ease,border-color .14s ease,transform .1s ease; } .ds-primary:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent-hover,var(--accent)) 90%,var(--text)); border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent-hover,var(--accent)) 90%,var(--text)); } .ds-primary:active { transform:scale(.97); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-primary:disabled { opacity:.5; cursor:default; }

components.name: Secondary action
components.description: A visible alternative inside a review, assignment, or detail action group.
components.css: .ds-secondary { min-height:44px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:10px 16px; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:10px; background:var(--surface); color:var(--text); font:500 14px var(--font); cursor:pointer; transition:background .14s ease,border-color .14s ease,transform .1s ease; } .ds-secondary:hover { background:var(--surface2,var(--surface)); border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 35%,var(--border)); } .ds-secondary:active { transform:scale(.97); } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Quiet action

components.name: Project directory filters

components.css: .ds-dock { position:relative; width:min(920px,calc(100% - 48px)); max-height:72dvh; overflow:auto; padding:24px; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:18px; background:var(--surface); color:var(--text); box-shadow:0 8px 40px color-mix(in srgb,var(--text) 14%,transparent); font-family:var(--font); } .ds-close { position:sticky; top:0; float:right; width:44px; min-height:44px; margin:-12px -10px 0 12px; border:0; background:var(--surface); color:var(--muted); font-size:22px; } .ds-dock h3 { margin:0 0 14px; padding-right:32px; font:650 22px/1.3 var(--font); letter-spacing:-.02em; } .ds-dock p { max-width:72ch; margin:10px 0 18px; color:var(--muted); font:400 16px/1.6 var(--font); } .ds-dock ul { padding:0; list-style:none; } .ds-dock li { padding:10px 0; } .ds-dock li span { display:block; color:var(--muted); font-size:14px; } .ds-dock details { margin-top:20px; padding-top:10px; border-top:1px solid var(--border); } .ds-dock summary,.ds-dock label { min-height:44px; color:var(--muted); font-size:14px; cursor:pointer; } .ds-dock label { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; } .ds-dock label input { width:18px; height:18px; accent-color:var(--accent); } .ds-dock footer { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px; margin-top:20px; } .ds-dock footer button { min-height:44px; padding:10px 16px; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:10px; background:var(--surface); color:var(--text); font:500 14px var(--font); } .ds-dock footer button:first-child { border-color:var(--accent-hover,var(--accent)); background:var(--accent-hover,var(--accent)); color:var(--accent-fg); } .ds-dock :is(button,input,summary):focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; } @media(max-width:680px) { .ds-dock { width:calc(100% - 16px); max-height:76dvh; padding:20px; border-radius:16px; } }

narrative.overview:
Contribute is one calm, project-shaped workspace rather than a dashboard of competing panes. A project directory leads into a continuous vertical document: project position, local work, decisions that need attention, saved private proposals, public contributions, and history appear in one readable flow. Technical depth stays available without displacing the next meaningful action.

Selection is a temporary working layer at the bottom of that document. Native checkboxes collect contributions without navigating; a compact stack of selected cards can expand, remove individual items, and launch review or assignment. Those workflows reuse the same bottom position as a focused, nonmodal dock while the project remains behind it. The shell owns both light and dark appearance, typography, icons, and semantic color.
keyCharacteristics: One continuous workspace per project; no persistent split pane or second review room.
Directory filters reflect real local-change and update facts.
Selection accumulates independently from contribution detail.
Review and assignment occupy a fixed bottom dock without resetting project scroll.
Description leads; Files and Activity load only when opened.
Exact contribution versions remain the unit of approval and refresh safety.

rules.name: Inherited Theme
rules.body: Use the shell’s semantic color and font variables in both light and dark modes. Do not freeze the accent into a named hue, manufacture a tonal ramp, or introduce an app-owned light/dark palette.

rules.name: Written State
rules.body: Color may reinforce a state, but labels such as “Ready for review,” “Needs you,” and “Prepared · not shared” carry the meaning.

rules.name: Readable Floor
rules.body: Do not shrink workflow copy below the established 14px label and 16px body sizes to fit more controls. Let controls wrap and layouts stack instead.

rules.name: Stable Inventory
rules.body: Checkbox selection changes only selection. It never opens detail, changes filters, scrolls the page, or steals focus.

rules.name: Continuous Context
rules.body: Tasks may focus attention, but they do not replace the project with another room or discard its place in the document.

rules.name: Temporary Lift
rules.body: Persistent project content stays flat; elevation belongs to the bottom selection/task surface or a transient control state.

rules.name: Purposeful Radius
rules.body: Radius signals interaction and temporary grouping. Do not turn every project section or contribution row into a floating card.

dos: Do keep each project as one continuous document from position through history.
Do make directory filters reflect the data conditions named by their labels.
Do keep native checkbox selection independent from row detail and keyboard focus.
Do preserve selected versions through refresh only when the exact head and base still match, and announce removals.
Do place selected work and review actions in the fixed bottom tray/dock while keeping the final inventory rows reachable.
Do preserve local-work and prepared-record summaries as readable text, not counts alone.
Do lead contribution detail with Description and defer Files and Activity until requested.
Do enumerate exact public effects and contribution versions before approval.
donts: Don't restore the discarded split-pane workspace, persistent task rail, or separate Reviews room.
Don't treat a row checkbox as navigation or clear selection merely because detail opened.
Don't make the bottom tray modal, reset project scroll, or discard selection while the review/assignment dock is open.
Don't hide changed-version removal; announce that the current version must be selected again.
Don't shrink labels below 14px or body copy below 16px to make the phone layout fit.
Don't invent fixed colors, tonal ramps, icons, approval states, or workflow capabilities outside the implemented semantic theme and product contract.
